data.narrative:
Lumina Vehicles is a Series A robotics and manufacturing company that has raised $8M+ to date. The valuation analysis draws on a comp universe of 9 private peers and 1 public comparable, spanning adjacent and same-stage companies in the robotics sector. The private peer set includes late-stage businesses such as Generalist AI ($2.0B, Series B), Bedrock Robotics ($1.8B, Series B), and Dexterity ($1.6B, Series B), alongside earlier-stage peers like Humanoid ($1.4B, Series A) and Walden Robotics ($1.1B, Seed).

Two valuation methods are applicable. Stage-progression anchors to Lumina's $8M total raised and applies a 2.0x step-up multiplier typical of Series A to subsequent-stage progression, yielding $16M. The peer-median method isolates five same-sector, same/adjacent-stage comparables with a median valuation of $1.6B and a range of $1.1B to $2.0B. These methods triangulate to a range of $14M (low) to $1.9B (high), with a median of $833M.

The wide dispersion between stage-progression and peer-median estimates reflects material stage and maturity differences within the comp set. Near-term valuation will depend on Lumina's progress on product commercialization, customer traction, and capital efficiency relative to the Series B cohort. The peer range itself ($1.1B–$2.0B) underscores valuation sensitivity to manufacturing readiness and addressable market capture assumptions.
